verdicts.rationale: The REST v2 /entities/search endpoint accepts requests without the annsField parameter and returns HTTP 200 with results. The contract formalizer marked annsField as 'required: true', but source code analysis (handler_v2.go:1420-1433) reveals this is conditionally required - auto-detection occurs when the collection has a single vector field. The code explicitly implements this graceful behavior with error handling only for the multiple-vector-field case (line 1430). This is intentional by-design API semantics for improved UX, not a defect. The contract formalizer failed to capture this conditional logic, resulting in contract_misread.
